title: He He He Ha (Clash Royale)
blurb: HE HE HE HA — the Clash Royale king's taunting laugh, the most punchable sound in mobile gaming. Emoted at you after every lost match, it transcended the game to become the internet's default troll laugh. Play it after winning anything, especially by luck, especially against someone who cares. Maximum disrespect in four syllables.
origin: The king's laugh emote from Clash Royale (Supercell), gaming's premier taunt.
